Test an association between categories

Source: vignettes/articles/docs/methods/associations.Rmd
associations.Rmd

Documentation / Methods

These methods test whether 2 categorical answers go together.

Assumptions. Use responses from independent respondents. The chi-square test needs expected counts of about 5 or more per cell, Fisher’s exact test does not.

In SurveyStudio, open Plan on the Design screen, add a research question and choose the method. Set 2 single-choice answers, 1 for the rows of the table and 1 for its columns. Declare the hypotheses and the decision rule before collecting responses.

Cross-tabulation

SurveyStudio’s Plan screen with the Edit Analysis Plan dialog for a Cross-tabulation research question, from the matrix_likert demo.

In the pre-analysis plan:

RQ3. Did in-person and online students rate the lectures differently? Null hypothesis (H0): The rating of the lectures does not depend on how the course was taken. Alternative hypothesis (H1): The rating of the lectures depends on how the course was taken. Planned decision rule: Reject H0 if p < .05, and report the effect size with its 95% confidence interval.

In the report: the APA 7 sentence and a table, with a chart where the method has one, each titled with the research question.

Chi-square test of association

SurveyStudio’s Plan screen with the Edit Analysis Plan dialog for a Chi-square test of association research question, from the categorical demo.

In the pre-analysis plan:

RQ2. Are format and preference associated? Null hypothesis (H0): Format and preferred session type are independent. Alternative hypothesis (H1): Format and preferred session type are associated. Planned decision rule: Reject H0 if p < .05, and report the effect size with its 95% confidence interval.

In the report: the APA 7 sentence and a table, with a chart where the method has one, each titled with the research question.

References: Field, A. (2018). Discovering statistics using IBM SPSS statistics (5th ed.). SAGE. Cohen, J. (1988). Statistical power analysis for the behavioral sciences (2nd ed.). Lawrence Erlbaum.

Fisher’s exact test

SurveyStudio’s Plan screen with the Edit Analysis Plan dialog for a Fisher’s exact test research question, from the categorical demo.

In the pre-analysis plan:

RQ3. Are format and preference associated, on an exact test for the small cell? Null hypothesis (H0): Format and preferred session type are independent. Alternative hypothesis (H1): Format and preferred session type are associated. Planned decision rule: Reject H0 if the exact p < .05, and report Cramer’s V.

In the report: the APA 7 sentence and a table, with a chart where the method has one, each titled with the research question.

References: Field, A. (2018). Discovering statistics using IBM SPSS statistics (5th ed.). SAGE. Cohen, J. (1988). Statistical power analysis for the behavioral sciences (2nd ed.). Lawrence Erlbaum.
